free_tier.stated: Free tier exists but is deliberately unspecified: 'You can try Seedr for free, with a low storage limit.' Paid tiers start at Basic $7.95/mo for 50 GB. No free GB figure is published anywhere on the site.

egress.terms: No daily/monthly cap on free users stated ('There are no daily or monthly limits for free users, and this can change at any time'), but the storage limit is the binding constraint.

tooling: Browser + browser extension + a 'Seedr Connector' desktop agent. FTP/FTPS/SFTP access is a paid feature (listed on Basic and above: 'FTP, FTPS & SFTP access'), and WebDAV appears only at Pro ('FTP, SFTP & WebDAV storages'). So on the free tier there is no programmatic transport at all.
chaining: Account multiplier is pointless: the free quota is 'low' and unpublished, and the useful transports (FTP/SFTP/WebDAV) are paywalled. Not a candidate.
limits_note: per-object-cap: not published. Request-rate: 'no daily or monthly limits for free users'. Retention: not published. The real limit is that FTP/SFTP/WebDAV are paid-plan features.
reliability_note: Quota is intentionally hidden, which is itself the finding — you cannot size a workload against an unpublished number.

evidence.proved: 'You can try Seedr for free, with a low storage limit. There are no daily or monthly limits for free users'
